breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines and applies the factor of safety as n = Sy/σ_avg (yield strength divided by average normal stress), explicitly stating 'The factor of safety is calculated as the yield strength divided by the average normal stress.' The computed value of 5.76 (≈ 275/47.7) confirms this correct formulation, not the inverted ratio from the incomplete prompt.
